simple.meaning: עֲבֹדָה (ʻăbôdâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “work of any kind.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 145 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 3 more, beginning at Genesis 29:27. Its contexts include death, kingship, Egypt, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עֲבֹדָה (H5656).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: עֲבֹדָה (ʻăbôdâh) / H5656 is traced through Genesis 29:27, Genesis 30:26, Exodus 1:14, Exodus 2:23 as a generated source-based concept entry.
